key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) turns Policy Mirror Descent for terminal-reward language generation into a trajectory-level objective, removing the need to estimate intermediate state values while preserving the same optimal solution.
engineering_relevance: BPO offers a simpler critic-free training recipe for reasoning LLMs, which can reduce implementation complexity and avoid instability from value-function estimation.
method: Use Bellman equations to rewrite PMD over full trajectories instead of intermediate states.
Optimize a practical BPO loss with a mismatch-correction weight based on a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities.
Keep the method critic-free by relying only on terminal rewards for autoregressive generation.
evidence_signal: The paper reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, indicating BPO improves reasoning performance in RLVR settings.
watch_item: The practical loss relies on an approximation and a probability-ratio weighting scheme, so training stability and sensitivity to this correction need careful tuning.
